scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師]
恭喜。
向戰士們致敬！

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
Do you want to
sing a song with me?
Sha la la la la~
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師]
想和我一起唱首歌嗎？
Sha la la la la~

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
The dreary world
of mortals is in need
of more cheerful song.
Will you bring it to them
and turn the tide in the
battle against evil?
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師]
沉悶的人間，需要更多歡快的歌聲。
你願意把歌聲帶給世人，扭轉對抗邪惡的戰局嗎？

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
Will you do this
for Midgard...
As a Minstrel?
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師]
你願意成為宮廷樂師，為米德加爾特獻出這份力量嗎？

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師]
準備好了，隨時回來吧。
向戰士們致敬！

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師]
你還有可以學習的技能。
請用完剩餘的技能點，再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
Congratulations!
As a Minstrel, your
your songs will bring
hope to your allies, and
desperation to your foes.
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師]
恭喜！
身為宮廷樂師，你的歌聲將為盟友帶來希望，讓敵人陷入絕望。

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師]
歡迎來到榮耀之廳——英靈殿。

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師]
在這裡安心休息吧。
向戰士們致敬！
